name: Skyworth / Coocaa 8R40_K5C (Realtek rtd285x, 1 GB, 32-bit), China domestic firmware
warnings: Stock launcher: com.tianci.movieplatform (hardcoded in /system/pcfg, DO NOT DISABLE).
Live TV / System UI: com.skyworth.tv (DO NOT DISABLE).

That page crashes if any of these are disabled: com.tianci.de com.skyworthdigital.stb.dataprovider com.coocaa.sky.ccapi A crashed About page means ADB can never be re-enabled: factory reset is the only way out.
DO NOT DISABLE com.tianci.movieplatform (stock launcher) or any other current launcher.
HOME is hardcoded in read-only /system/pcfg and no package declares category HOME, so disabling the launcher gives a black screen on boot (sys.boot_completed never set). 3.
